findings.title: The two §5.2/§5.3 'appended at the END of the branch' placement rows (former r4-l1-a9-005) are STILL UNPINNED — the fold into r4-l1-a9-002 did not close them
findings.detail: Run 4 folded a9-005 into a9-002 and the FAILURE-REPORT's fix #2 claims the subscription.deleted ledger-failure example 'also closes a9-005'. It does not, and neither does any other example at 33dffbe3e. Both ledger-failure examples stub CreateSubscriptionEvent.call to raise WITH the insertion's own begin/rescue intact: the inner rescue catches, execution continues, and every earlier existing line runs regardless of where the block sits. Moving the invoice.paid block (stripe_webhook_handler_job.rb:315-333) above organization_ai_credit_balance&.reset_ai_credits — or even above the organization.update — leaves all 8 invoice.paid examples green (assertions are effect-based: period-end written, payment-method received, reset_ai_credits received, logger regex, row attributes; none order-sensitive). Moving the deleted block (:213-226) above organization&.sync_with_stripe leaves all 4 deleted-path examples green for the same reason. The original a9-005 fix shape (stub an EXISTING line — reset_ai_credits / EngagementReport::GeneratorJob.perform_later — to raise and assert NO row is written, which fails iff the block sits below the raising line) was never implemented. Production delta unchanged from run 4 (narrow): reordered, a conversion row would be written for a delivery whose branch failed, and the once-ever uniqueness index would classify the successful Stripe redelivery as a duplicate. Residual structural backstop, stated for orchestrator adjudication: the D11 delicacy diff-read (matrix row 55, re-verified this round: the webhook file's full-range diff is 34 pure insertions, both blocks sitting at the end of their else-branch bodies) verifies placement per QA round by reading, not by a falsifiable example — the same status the two N/A rows hold. Orchestrator options: implement the original a9-005 fix shape, or reclassify both rows as diff-read-verified/accepted with the fold's 'also closes' claim corrected.
